ex.t: I wish I had more time.
I wish I had studied harder then.
If only he were here now.
ex.ko: 그가 지금 여기 있다면 얼마나 좋을까요.
저는 그 직장을 그만둔 것을 후회해요.

ex.t: I missed the chance to work abroad.
If I'd gone then, I would have met her.
If I'd left earlier that day, I wouldn't have been late.
ex.ko: 그날 일찍 출발했더라면 늦지 않았을 거예요.

explain.ko: I wish + 과거형은 현재의 사실과 다른 소망을, I wish + had + 과거분사는 과거에 대한 후회를 나타냅니다. If only는 같은 뜻이지만 더 강한 감정을 담습니다. 제3조건문 If + 과거완료, would have + 과거분사는 과거에 일어나지 않은 일의 가정과 결과를 말합니다(If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus). I wish 뒤에서 be동사는 were를 쓸 수 있습니다. 후회는 regret + -ing(했던 일)로도 말합니다.
explain.en: I wish + past simple expresses a wish about the present that isn't true, and I wish + had + past participle expresses regret about the past. If only means the same but is stronger. The third conditional, If + past perfect, would have + past participle, talks about an unreal past condition and its result (If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus). After I wish, 'were' can be used for all subjects. You can also express regret with regret + -ing (something you did).

rows: I wish I had more time.
I wish I had studied harder.
If + past perfect, would have + p.p.

notes.ko: wish 뒤의 과거형은 과거가 아니라 '현재의 사실과 다름'을 나타냅니다.
notes.en: The past tense after wish shows an unreal present, not past time.

notes.ko: 제3조건문의 if절에는 would를 쓰지 않습니다: If I had known (not If I would have known).
notes.en: Do not use would in the if-clause: If I had known (not If I would have known).

notes.ko: 회화에서는 had와 would를 'd로 줄이므로 문맥으로 구분합니다.
notes.en: In speech had and would are both 'd, so use the context to tell them apart.

questions.q: What does the man wish he had done?

lines.t: Now that I'm turning eighty, I have a few regrets. I wish I had travelled more when I was young. If I had spent more time with my family, I would have been happier. But I'm not only looking back; I can still learn new things.

trans.ko: 저는 80세에 접어든 지금 몇 가지 후회가 있습니다. 젊을 때 더 많이 여행했더라면 좋았을 텐데요. 가족과 더 많은 시간을 보냈더라면 더 행복했을 겁니다. 하지만 후회만 하고 있지는 않습니다. 지금도 새로운 것을 배울 수 있으니까요.

questions.q: What does the speaker wish he had done?

lines.t: The laptop I bought last week has broken. I wish I had kept the receipt.
Don't worry. Could you give me the order number?

trans.ko:

직원: 걱정 마세요. 주문 번호를 알려 주시겠어요?

items.passage:
A LIFE WITHOUT REGRETS
Researchers say that people regret what they didn't do more than what they did. Many said they regretted spending too much time at work and not keeping in touch with the people close to them. Experts advise us to start making small changes right now.

trans.ko:
후회 없는 인생
연구자들은 사람들이 가장 크게 후회하는 것은 한 일보다 하지 않은 일이라고 말합니다. 많은 사람이 일에 너무 많은 시간을 썼다는 점, 그리고 가까운 사람들과 더 자주 연락하지 않았다는 점을 후회한다고 답했습니다. 전문가는 지금 바로 작은 변화를 시작하라고 조언합니다.

items.passage: Steve turned down a chance to study abroad as an exchange student at university. Now he thinks his life would have been different if he had gone. But he is learning a new language to make up for that regret.

trans.ko: 스티브는 대학 시절 해외 교환학생 기회를 거절했어요. 이제 그는 그때 갔더라면 인생이 달라졌을 거라고 생각해요. 하지만 지금은 새로운 언어를 배우면서 그 후회를 달래고 있어요.

expressions.t: If I had ~ed, I would have ~ed.

prompt.ko: 소망과 후회를 3문장으로 써 보세요: 현재의 소망, 과거에 대한 후회, 과거에 다르게 했다면 일어났을 일.
prompt.en: Write 3 sentences about wishes and regrets: a wish about now, a regret about the past, and what would have happened if you had acted differently.

must_include.label: If I had ~ed, I would have ~ed

task.model: I wish I had more time. I wish I had kept learning the piano as a child. If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.

model_trans.ko: 더 많은 시간이 있으면 좋겠어요. 어릴 때 피아노를 계속 배웠더라면 좋았을 텐데요. 일찍 출발했더라면 기차를 놓치지 않았을 거예요.
model_trans.en: I wish I had more time. I wish I had kept learning the piano as a child. If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the train.
